findings.summary: EvaluatorMetric.UniqueVerifiedDefects attributes family-level exclusivity to individual runs, double-counting unique defects when multiple runs of the same family identify the same cluster
evidence: Lines 434-436 use len(clusterFamilies[finding.ClusterKey]) == 1 to identify unique verified clusters
This loop evaluates for each run in the batch, causing multiple runs of the same ModelFamily to independently credit the same finding as a UniqueVerifiedDefect for their respective run metrics

findings.summary: VerifyTwinSnapshot checks only the self-referential digest of the TwinSnapshot fields without independently evaluating the authoritative TemporalFacts and TwinRequirements, allowing forged unprovenanced state to back advisory recommendations
evidence: RecommendationSnapshot bridges TwinSnapshot into solver evidence using only VerifyTwinSnapshot, meaning a maliciously crafted TwinSnapshot with Complete=true and fake values is accepted as authoritative evidence without cryptographic linkage
VerifyTwinSnapshot asserts id == snapshot.ID where the ID is simply the SHA256 of the snapshot's own asserted fields

findings.summary: NewEvaluatorResolution permanently locks findings that are implicitly unresolved by omission, as it requires an explicit DispositionUnresolved entry in the batch
evidence: MeasureEvaluatorBatch correctly treats omitted dispositions as unresolved, but NewEvaluatorResolution rejects resolving them because they are not present in the unresolved map
NewEvaluatorResolution populates its unresolved map strictly from batch.Dispositions entries with Status == DispositionUnresolved
